    for (int i = 0; i + 2 < s.size(); i++) {
        if (s.substr(i, 3) == "dot" && i != (int)s.size()-3) {
            reps.push_back({i, '.'});
        }

        }

    sort(reps.begin(), reps.end());
    string ans;
    int cur = 0;
    for (auto &p : reps) {
        ans += s.substr(cur, p.first - cur);
        ans += p.second;
        if (p.second == '.') cur = p.first + 3;
        else cur = p.first + 2;
    }
    ans += s.substr(cur);
    cout << ans;
}
